response: Run SchedulerBuilder as a separate scheduler host. It emits an event to an event-to-queue binding, where a queue worker performs billing. Use RedisSchedulerProvider from @purista/redis-scheduler-provider and setRequireDistributedClaims. Reject DefaultSchedulerProvider for replicas because it is local-only. Delivery is at-least-once, so use occurrenceId for downstream idempotency.
